header: The back office of a garden centre before and after
lead: The same wall, photographed at the end of March and again in the middle of May. Nothing was tidied for the second picture.
caption: Fennwood Garden Centres, Wiener Neustadt branch.
note: The whiteboard, the clock-card rack and the folder of swap notes all came down in the same week. What replaced them is one tablet by the staff entrance and a plan that everybody already has on their phone.
